209. The Seventh Tomb of Temar – Ketam's Picture (5)
The Ten Great Knights looked at Jin and Murakan in turn. Murakan emphasized that he had no intention to fight as he transformed into a human.
"Yeah! Looking at you guys, it seems like you're a bit short-handed. Temar's injured and fleeing, but where are the others? Why is it just the three of you?"
"The others are..."
Just as Dranacus was about to answer, Frey raised his hand to stop him.
"They are all on external missions. They should be back soon."
Murakan believed Frey's words as they were, but Jin immediately recognized the lie.

'They probably want to hide their power since they can't trust us yet. But, probably, the current members present are likely the maximum power of the Storm Castle. They're not preparing for an ambush or a surprise attack.'
They had taken a combat stance, assuming that the 'fake Murakan' had initiated a frontal assault. Of course, if they had more of the Ten Great Knights and troops, they would have all been deployed.
"I see."
"We haven't heard your answer yet. How do you explain that outfit and the Witch's Red Jade Charm? Vamel."

"The clothes were made by the Myeongwang tribe in Lafrarosa for Temar in the past. They said to wear it when my training ended, but I forgot about it. So, I wore it when I left this time. The Red Jade Charm is named Shuri, Solderet picked it up after it was abandoned by Heluram."
"It was in Lafrarosa as well?"
"Yes. It received the curse of immortality from the witch before being abandoned, so it's a pitiful child."
Frey was silent for a while, locking eyes with Jin. It was not easy to gauge whether his words were true or not.

"...So to summarize, you are a secret weapon prepared by Solderet. The Murakan here was fooled by a fake in the past, has been under treatment since, had problems with his memory... and has returned to fight for the family again. Is that correct?"
"Yes, Knight Frey."
Frey fell into thought for a moment.
If their words were true, an unexpected reinforcement had appeared. There seemed to be hope for executing the fake Murakan.
'But if by any chance this is a scheme of the witch....'
Just as Frey was thinking that far, Jin untied Sigmund and held it out to them.

"If Murakan and I were enemies, there would be no reason to go this far. Even if I were a witch, I don't think she would send someone like me or Murakan just to act as a spy. If we were in league with the fake Murakan and attacked this place together, the fall of the Storm Castle would be inevitable. I can't think of any other way to show more trust, so I'm handing over the remaining sword as well."
"Even without a sword, you don't seem like the type to get weaker."
"You can bind us if you like."
"Even if you bind us with ancient iron, it seems like we wouldn't be the kind to be suppressed."

"Ah, so what are you trying to do, Frey! Can you consider my position as well? I mean, after being fooled by the fake, I just barely recovered and ran straight back to the family. But Temar is fleeing from the fake, and you're attacking me. How do you think I feel? Ah, damn it!"
"Murakan, calm down."

"Ah, do I look calm! No, what explanation would work just by talking? Where is that fake bastard? Even if you just have a rough idea, tell me. If the kid and I go and get his neck, you have no choice but to believe us. The two of us are enough, so hurry up and tell us."
It wasn't an act, Murakan really raised his voice in frustration. Even though it was a situation within a picture, it felt like a vivid reality to him.
"Do you plan to feel sorry later when you realize that I'm the real Murakan? Hurry up and tell us! If you don't want to tell us, the kid and I will just go looking for him. Let's go, kid!"
It seemed better to go along with him. When Jin shrugged his shoulders and asked for his sword back, Frey finally nodded his head.

"Okay, I'll believe you. That the Murakan who is currently committing betrayal and massacre is a fake... I really, desperately want to believe it. I've doubted millions of times whether that demon was really the Black Dragon we knew."
"Frey, are you sure?"
"Why are you making a fuss when Frey says he'll believe? Biolo. Do you think you're smarter than Frey?"
"Dranacus, I was just asking... But you've been picking fights since earlier."
"What, do you not like it? Do you want to have a go?"

"Both of you stop. We've decided to believe, so they are now a returned friend and a person whom the Lord and God have arranged for us. Especially Dranacus, it's troublesome if you keep showing such an inadequate side."
"Yeah, sorry."
Frey returned the swords to Jin.

"Vamel, you seem like a wise person, so I think you will understand why we doubted. For us, accepting you and Murakan is like a gamble. Honestly, we want to spend more time verifying... but the situation isn't that good."

"Of course, I understand, Knight Frey. It would be difficult for you to completely believe until you see me fight alongside you. But once we fight together, you'll know. I'm someone who's ready to lay down my life for Runcandel at any time."
"How can you do that? You said you trained in Lafrarosa with the help of Solderet, but in reality, you seem to have no connection with the family."
"It was determined like that from the moment of birth."
"Right, since the child's ego began to form, he only trained to fight for Runcandel. It's like having an unrequited love without the family knowing."
"That means there was another cruel side to Solderet. As if he made one person lead a desolate life from the moment of birth for Runcandel."
Murakan did not answer with a hum. Jin noted that they did not have a purely positive perception of Solderet.
-Everyone... Damn it! Solderet, you bastard betrayer! Is this what you mean by keeping your promises! Come out, show yourself, you damned...!
-Silderay! If you act like this, what about the other Eaters? Please calm down!
-It was not the guardian who made the head of the family like this. Lower your voice, Sir Silderay.
-If it's not Solderet, who made the head of the family like this? Where the hell was that incompetent god when the head of the family was suffering?
The scream of Silderay from the record video of the first tomb came to mind. As well as the appearance of Temar, who was lying unconscious in the sickbed.
At that time, Diana scolded Silderay and told him to follow the 'Last Command of the Head of the Family.'
"…You guys probably thought Temar was hit by me, so you could hate Solderet. But what was the thing Vyollo said earlier? He shouted that the witch promised to stop Solderet's extinction."

"Murakan, you seem to have a big problem with your memory. Even the extinction of the god you serve is forgotten. Solderet was already gradually disappearing before the contract with the head of the family. We and Jifel knew this."
Jin's pupils widened.
'Then, the disconnection with Solderet before my return is related......'
However, since the history he is currently viewing in the picture is not intact, he could not make a hasty judgment.

'But it's certain that Solderet has not completely disappeared. There's a high chance that it's in a situation where it has to hide for some reason. If it had disappeared, not only my aura, but also Murakan and Miss Misha would not have been able to maintain their form. Or, it's extinct, and all the remaining power was left to me and the Black Dragons......'
Either way, Jin was guessing that Solderet used all his remaining power for himself, Murakan, and Misha. Including 'return.'
"Was it? Damn, I don't remember at all. Then does the witch have a way to stop the extinction?"
"I don't know. But even if there is, it won't be a normal way. It will require a lot... of sacrifices."
"Ah, of course, I don't even think about asking for help from the witch. No matter what happens, I won't do such a thing. It was just a thought, so don't doubt or suspect me."

"It was nonsense that I can accept enough thinking you are the real Murakan. Anyway, I'm glad you're back, Murakan. You've forgotten a lot, but it's fortunate that you remember your given mission and our names."
"I said this to Dranax earlier, but I felt like I couldn't live forgetting you. The moment I see you, it comes up so clearly. Hehe, the saint of Hamarlen must have had a crush on me."
"How dare you say that in front of the person concerned, Murakan. Even the old stories. Has your shamelessness not improved even after losing your memory?"
"That's right, shall we say the dark history of Frey... What's good about that guy?"
"That's right, why is Vyollo saying all the right things? How could you choose Murakan over a cool man like me?"
"I always have similar opinions to Frey or the housekeeper, right? You're just the one who always argues. And you're closer to a beast than a man, Dranax."
"Ah, where is Ruet?"
"The housekeeper doesn't know the exact location as she is serving the family head, Murakan."
"Are you hiding because you still don't trust us?"
"I really don't know. But even if I knew, I wouldn't have answered. If we are needed, the family head will contact us first."
"Okay, anyway, it means that it is difficult to see us as a complete family until we kill the fake guy. Can I go now to catch that guy?"
"You can't. You two should stay here and protect the storm fortress with us."
"Why? On the way here, I heard from the villagers that he's tearing up the whole Huphester region. Isn't it better to find and hit him before more innocent people die?"
Frey hesitated for a moment while choosing his answer.
"Lord Frey, I think there is something we need to protect in this storm fortress."
"It's hard to hide anything from you, Vamel. Yes, there's something in the Storm Fortress that fake Murakan is after. That's why he's attacking everywhere in Huphester. He's trying to lure us."
"May I ask what that thing is? If you don't feel like it, you don't have to tell me. Anyway, Murakan and I will wait and anticipate the fake Murakan's attack."
Frey stared at Jin for a while, then finally gave an answer.
"... Barisada, the lord's sword. That's what the fake Murakan is after."
"Huh? Barisada? What does the fake guy want to use that for?"
"In the past, Solderet said to the lord that Barisada is not just a sword, but also a key to somewhere."
